goal: Make rare filesystem exceptions in disk-space checks and file allocation abort predictably instead of crashing unpredictably
Gives users and maintainers consistent, diagnosable behavior when hardware or I/O issues occur
reviewability: Ready: no CI failures or rebase issues, author actively pushing and replying
Architectural disagreement exists but does not block reviewing the current diff
agreement: Disputed: several reviewers argue aborting is the wrong layer or approach for rare I/O exceptions (josibake, sedited, furszy)
Nonblocking objection: prefers higher-level context-aware error handling over low-level abort (optout21)
Author actively disputes the objections without resolution reached (maflcko)
Unresolved conflict with two other open PRs taking a different, more graceful approach
